items.title: Boost secures Lloyd's Coverholder approval and expands reinsurance panel
items.summary: Specialty managing general agent platform Boost has obtained Lloyd's Coverholder approval and added nine new global reinsurance partners to its panel.

items.title: Marsh selects Mobius for workplace pension investment solution
items.summary: Marsh has chosen Mobius as the provider for its defined contribution investment-only workplace pension solution, granting schemes access to various pooled and segregated funds.

items.title: Privy Council rules recycled stolen funds cannot reduce director's liability in Enterprise Insurance collapse
items.summary: The Privy Council has ruled that the former managing director of Enterprise Insurance Company cannot offset £32.3 million in capital recycled from the insurer's own stolen funds against his damages liability.

items.title: BlackRock retains top asset management brand ranking as sector values rise
items.summary: BlackRock has been named the world's most valuable asset management brand for the third consecutive year, with a valuation of $9.7bn.

items.title: Bobcat Re renews and expands underwriting facilities for 2027
items.summary: Managing general agent Bobcat Re has renewed and expanded its property treaty underwriting facilities across the US, Caribbean, and Japan for 2027.

items.title: EY survey reveals institutional private markets investors view illiquidity as top concern
items.summary: More than half of institutional investors in private markets point to illiquidity as a primary worry, according to EY data.
